race.description: The Ary, Toukley C1 & Mdn Plate
race.comment: LIYAH'S GIRL (3) is the horse to beat after two solid Canberra runs, the latest a fifth beaten just under two lengths after being checked late, and her record of four placings from five starts at the distance gives her the right grounding for 2030m. FREDDIE BASSETT (2) brings the strongest class reference, dropping out of a BM72 at Newcastle where he was only beaten a length and a half after being bumped and covering ground, with the first try at this trip the main query. SCOISH MALOISH (11) is still a maiden but was checked when fourth, beaten just under a length, at Hawkesbury and looks ready to improve third-up. Ready for this trip. DON'S PARTY (1) one paced type who gets the tongue-tie going on after he dropped in trip with a battling sixth over 1600m at Kembla Grange.  Capable of better in the small field.
